changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla video_feedback: calificación del aprendiz sobre un video (útil, problema de audio, desactualizado, muy largo). Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría video_feedback_audit y el trigger video_feedback_audit_trg.

column.name: enrollment_id
column.remarks: Enrollment of the learner that rated

column.name: rating
column.remarks: Rating: useful, audio_issue, outdated or too_long

column.name: watched_fully
column.remarks: Whether the learner watched the whole video

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE video_feedback ADD CONSTRAINT video_feedback_rating_ck CHECK (rating IN ('useful', 'audio_issue', 'outdated', 'too_long'))
CREATE TRIGGER video_feedback_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON video_feedback FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in video_feedback

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE video_feedback_audit ADD CONSTRAINT video_feedback_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER video_feedback_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON video_feedback FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS video_feedback_audit_trg ON video_feedback
